column1: # The boot-verify run's payload: every check that cannot run on a push.
# These seven are not unwired and not excused - they need a built image, a live
# bus or running software, so a CI runner cannot host them. Naming them here
# turns "somebody should run these against an image" into a definition of what
# the boot-verify run IS, which is the difference between a plan and a list.
# `check-wired.py` holds this file and its own computed local-only set to be the
# same set, so neither can quietly drift from the other.
# WHERE says what the entry needs, and it is not a preference:
#   image   runs on the HOST against the built image file, before or without
#           booting it - inspection, not execution.
#   guest   runs INSIDE a booted system, because it needs the daemons up and the
#           sockets bound. There is no shell into the VM, so an entry here
#           arrives as a unit whose output goes to the console.
# script<TAB>where<TAB>what it proves
check-image-contents.sh
column3: every unit's ExecStart names a binary the image actually ships

column1: probe-dbus-gate.sh
column3: the bus policy refuses a caller the gate is supposed to refuse

column1: probe-launch-socket.py
column3: the launch socket answers, attests its peer and refuses an unnamed one

column1: probe-served-objects.sh
column3: each daemon serves the objects its interface claims

column1: smoke-daemons.sh

column1: smoke-apps.sh
